summary: Overstay of leave without sufficient cause; appellant pleaded guilty during Summary Court Martial; habitual offender with prior punishments for absence without leave; medical justification for wife's illness unproven; dismissal upheld as proportionate for Armed Forces discipline; procedural compliance confirmed; High Court/AFT dismissal of appeal endorsed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned orders of AFT and respondents upheld; dismissal from service sustained.
